name: Biometric Keychain Vault
summary: Platform-agnostic biometric authentication and encrypted credential storage interface
description:
## Biometric Keychain Vault

Provides a secure, platform-agnostic abstraction for storing authentication tokens and credentials guarded by biometric authorization (Touch ID, Face ID, Windows Hello) with software fallbacks for headless/CI environments.

### Capabilities
- Biometric gating on read/write operations
- Secure PBKDF2/AES-GCM encryption in software mode
- Token rotation and automatic invalidation
- Zero third-party dependencies
